name: pfcpl3
description: Paging #PF on a HIGH not-present page (linear 0x10001000, PD index 64) — the EXACT page-walk class + high CR2 the DOS-Quake go32 server demand-pages (qemu v=0e e=0006 CR2=0x10001000). Proves Ventium walks UPPER PD entries + raises #PF with the high CR2 bit-exactly vs qemu. Also keeps the low 0x401000 #PF.
